paragraphs: Mentioned in Mishnah Orlah, chapter 2, mishnah 12. He was one of Beit Shammai’s students and said, “I asked Rabban Gamliel the Elder, standing at the eastern gate,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The exact Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Orlah 2:12 text explicitly spells בית שמאי and רבן גמליאל הזקן in this Yoezer/eastern-gate report, supporting both expansions and the full Rabban title. It does not establish a broader identity beyond the occurrence. Ish HaBira preserves the definite article without a new Temple/place binding. The standing phrase is retained without a new ruling about whether it attaches to asker or addressee; source וכו׳ remains etc. No unquoted legal continuation is inserted.
